examples.prompt: Compose an engaging travel blog post about a recent trip to Hawaii, highlighting cultural experiences and must-see attractions.
examples.response:
This blog post will demonstrate some of the experiences of the local people that have participated in the event. What you can do with the post will be much appreciated. See for yourself….
The Pacific Islands region consists of almost 3000 islands over a 22,000 mile coastline along the coast of Baja, Mexico. The islands are surrounded by hundreds of other islands in the Pacific Ocean. The largest islands in the area are Samoa, Tonga, Hawaii, Johnston Islands, Johnston. Johnston’s islands have a number of active volcanoes, and on the Johnston Islands, the active volcano is Fuego Volcano.
The Pacific Islands is a group of 12 islands and 3 overseas territories in the region of Micronesia and Polynesia. The Pacific Islands are a group of islands over a 22,000 mile mile coastline. The islands have been inhabited prior to the arrival of Europeans – the first recorded discovery was in 1508, after a Dutch ship arrived on the islands. The territory was inhabited by Polynesian tribes and it was then ruled by the US in the 1850s. In 1959, Japan invaded the islands and established a military dictatorship. The islands remained Japanese property until October 1999 and are now part of Japan. (source)
The island of Hawaii is the most populous of the US Pacific Islands region. In 2018 there were approx. 3,350
